title: TemplateVersionPublished.v1
description: Hook emitted by the existing Templates Service when a template version is published. Raw input of ms-template-catalog, which validates it into the version DAG. Template metadata only, no firm data.
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.3 catalog EV-01; RF-001, RF-086; US-01.1.2. Producer: templates-service. Consumers: ms-template-catalog. Channel: templates-service outbox -> global EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS FIFO global-ms-template-catalog-templates-service.fifo. Ordering/partition key: templateId (FIFO MessageGroupId). Idempotency key: eventId; publishId. Guarantee: at-least-once, ordered per template (FIFO). Versioning: contract with the platform team (owner of the Templates Service); additive within v1. dataClass: TEMPLATE_PUBLIC (DISENO 4.3). Template metadata only; stays in the home region (not replicated to cells).
x-channel: templates-service outbox -> global EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS FIFO global-ms-template-catalog-templates-service.fifo

publishId.description: Publish id issued for this publication (root correlationId of the publish flow, DISENO 7.2).

parentVersions.description: Parent version labels (0..n; 2 or more on a merge, PRD 2.1).

publishedAt.description: Publication instant in the Templates Service.
